metrics.rationale: User states '8000-11000 nm 长波红外大气窗口，需要该波段尽可能高的透过率' - directly calls for maximizing transmittance in this working band.
User states '尽可能抑制 3000-5000 nm 中波红外的热背景辐射，以降低焦平面的热负载' - suppressing thermal background requires minimizing transmittance in this band.

standard.metric_rationale: These two metrics directly capture the dual-band requirement: high transmission in the 8000-11000 nm LWIR working band for detector signal, and low transmission in the 3000-5000 nm MWIR band to block thermal background radiation. I deliberately chose mean_transmittance over worst_case variants because the user's phrasing ('尽可能高/抑制') indicates average band performance rather than pointwise guarantees. I omitted emissivity/absorption metrics because the user explicitly framed requirements in terms of transmittance (透过率) and thermal background suppression through transmission blocking, not emission control. The 2-metric set stays well under the 4-metric maximum to avoid diluting the core performance objectives.
standard.formula_rationale: This expression directly encodes the dual objective by rewarding high transmittance in the 8000-11000 nm working band through addition, while enforcing the suppression of 3000-5000 nm thermal background by subtracting that transmittance value. Subtracting the second variable satisfies the 'minimize' direction requirement so that a lower background transmission results in a higher overall score. No weighting coefficients are applied because both metrics are fractions on the same 0-1 scale and the user request treats maximizing the working band and minimizing the background band as equally critical priorities.
